name: PaperBench
intro: PaperBench是一个旨在评测AI代理复现顶尖人工智能研究能力的基准。它要求代理从零开始，完整复现20篇ICML 2024的重点论文，涵盖了从理解论文贡献、开发代码到执行实验的全过程。该基准采用一个包含8316个可评分子任务的分层评分体系进行客观评估，并配备了一个基于大型语言模型的自动评分机制以实现规模化评测。
build_method: 论文筛选, 双工程师分层rubric, 原作者多轮核验, JudgeEval验证
eval_feature: 全新Ubuntu 24.04环境, A10 GPU, 12小时复现实验, SimpleJudge逐叶节点判定, 加权树聚合
scale: 20篇论文, 12个ICML主题, 8,316个叶节点评分结果
build_method_en: Paper filtering, two-engineer hierarchical rubrics, multi-round author verification, JudgeEval validation
eval_feature_en: Fresh Ubuntu 24.04 VM, A10 GPU, 12-hour reproduction, per-leaf SimpleJudge decisions, weighted tree aggregation
intro_en: PaperBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate AI agents' ability to replicate cutting-edge AI research. It requires agents to fully reproduce 20 key ICML 2024 papers from scratch, covering the entire process from understanding the paper's contributions, developing code, to executing experiments. The benchmark uses a hierarchical scoring system with 8,316 scorable subtasks for objective evaluation and features an LLM-based automatic scoring mechanism for scalable assessment.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.01848 and OpenAI's official PaperBench implementation. Automated eligibility filters and author outreach yield 20 ICML 2024 Spotlight/Oral papers across 12 topics. Two engineers draft weighted hierarchical rubrics, followed by internal review, multi-round original-author verification, and addenda. Candidates receive only the paper and addendum, run reproduce.sh for at most 12 hours in a fresh Ubuntu 24.04 A10 VM, and are judged leaf-by-leaf by SimpleJudge; weighted roll-up produces Replication Score. JudgeEval uses expert gold labels on partial replications and reports 0.83 F1 for o3-mini.
